messages.content:
<role>
You check one property (signal) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is this a problem with Keelwater's product that a squad could act on? Pass means yes.
Fail if the cause is outside the product (pricing, contracts, the customer's own IT, staffing), if a help article would have answered it, or if it is praise.
A feature request or a described workaround is signal.
The evidence is the title, the problem statement and up to 12 customer quotes with route and date.
</definition>
<evidence>
{
 "title": "Frustrating document type selection",
 "problem_statement": "Users repeatedly click 'Document type' without success, leading to frustration. This wastes time and blocks progress because the interface doesn't clearly respond to their actions.",
 "quotes": [
  {
   "quote": "Documents: click \"Document type\", rage x5... Documents: click \"Open\"",
   "route": "sessions",
   "date": "2026-09-23T09:05:00Z"
  },
  {
   "quote": "Documents: click \"Open\"\nDocuments: click \"Save\", rage x3",
   "route": "sessions",
   "date": "2026-09-16T10:04:00Z"
  },
  {
   "quote": "Suppliers: click \"Open\" ... click \"Save\", rage x3",
   "route": "sessions",
   "date": "2026-09-09T14:19:00Z"
  },
  {
   "quote": "click \"Document type\", rage x5...click \"Save\"",
   "route": "sessions",
   "date": "2026-09-14T15:35:00Z"
  },
  {
   "quote": "Documents: click \"Document type\", rage x5... Documents: click \"Open\"",
   "route": "sessions",
   "date": "2026-09-05T14:45:00Z"
  },
  {
   "quote": "Documents: click \"Document type\", rage x5",
   "route": "sessions",
   "date": "2026-09-03T12:51:00Z"
  }
 ]
}
</evidence>
<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.
</task>
<output>
JSON only: {"critique": string, "verdict": "pass" | "fail"}
</output>

response.content: {"critique": "The title and problem statement claim users repeatedly fail when clicking 'Document type', and the session quotes support this: five of six quotes show repeated rage clicks on 'Document type' or related save/open actions in Documents across multiple sessions in September. This is an in-product usability issue with a clear, actionable UI behavior (non-responsive control), not pricing, contracts, customer IT, or a help-article answer. No praise or out-of-product cause is present.", "verdict": "pass"}
